subject: sentences
title: Capital letters
about: He finds the one word in a sentence that needs a capital letter: the first word, the word I, or a name or date (a person's name, a day, a month). These are exactly the three capitalization rules North Carolina expects by the end of first grade.
tip: Ask him why that word gets a capital: is it first, is it I, or is it a name?

cards.q: the dog is big. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: The first word of a sentence always starts with a capital.

cards.q: a cat can nap. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: Even a tiny word like a gets a capital when it starts the sentence.

cards.q: it is hot. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: The first word starts with a capital, so it becomes It.

cards.q: a pig can dig. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: The first word starts with a capital, so a becomes A.

cards.q: ducks can swim. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: The first word starts with a capital, so ducks becomes Ducks.

cards.q: Sam and i ran. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: The word I is always a capital letter.

cards.q: Can i have a snack? Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: The word I is a capital even in the middle of a question.

cards.q: Yes, i can hop. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: The word I is a capital no matter where it sits in the sentence.

cards.q: The dog ran to pam. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: A person's name starts with a capital.

cards.q: I sat with ben. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: Ben is a person's name, so it starts with a capital.

cards.q: Did max get the bag? Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: Max is a person's name, so it starts with a capital.

cards.q: Mom and kim had jam. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: Kim is a person's name, so it starts with a capital.

cards.q: We swim on sunday. Which word needs a capital letter?
cards.note: Days of the week start with a capital.

cards.q: It is hot in july. Which word needs a capital letter?
